name: MoNuSAC 2020: Multi-Organ Nuclei Segmentation and Classification Challenge
description: MoNuSAC 2020 (ISBI 2020 Challenge) is an advanced computational pathology benchmark extending generalized nuclear segmentation to multi-class cell sub-typing. Curated from 71 patients (46 train, 25 test) across 37 hospitals and 4 organs (breast, kidney, lung, prostate), it comprises exactly 46,144 manually delineated nuclei classified into 4 cell types: epithelial, lymphocyte, neutrophil, and macrophage. Whole-slide histological regions in .svs and .tif format at 40x magnification contain 31,000 training nuclei annotations and 15,144 testing nuclei annotations, alongside binary masks identifying ambiguous histological areas with faint or fuzzy cell boundaries.
